Pulse 0.11.1

What's new:
- Pulse has a new visual identity built around its original market waveform. The redesigned app icon uses a deep navy field, a crisp white trace, and a blue live tail that carries the idea of prices updating in real time.
- The same waveform now runs consistently through the menu bar, popover header, chart loading state, and exported market snapshots.

What's improved:
- Watchlist rows now share the same outer alignment rails as the header and streaming status, while keeping comfortable spacing around names, charts, and prices.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.11.1.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
